Container.Name: The Shelf
Container.Overview: Your monthly romance page — new books curated to your taste, every 1st of the month. It finds new sport romance & romantasy releases, OpenAI-.. curates them with your taste profile (trad-pub first, no dark romance, spice 3-5), and serves the page. Add your OpenRouter key and pick your model in the in-page Settings.
Container.Description: THE SHELF is a monthly book-discovery app: one page, 6-8 new romance titles (sport romance + romantasy), curated for one reader. It fetches candidates automatically, applies her rules (M/F only, no dark romance, trad-pub first with indie only when proven, spice 3-5, releases from the past two months), curates them with the model of your choice via OpenRouter, and rebuilds the page. Scheduled to run the 1st of every month, plus a manual "run now" button in Settings. All settings (API key, model) live in the page under "shelf settings" - nothing to edit in the container.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Schedule runs run in this timezone (1st of month, 09:00)

Config.Description: Must match the /config volume (settings.json + logs persist here)
